en:
Hmm... This isn't quite the mood I was
expecting, but...

It's okay! At least now you guys seem like
you're getting into it!
You again!? The fuck are you doin' here!?

Puhuhu... Don't be so crude. I've come to
bring you all a wonderful present.
This is giving me the heebie-jeebies.

Dun dun dunnnn! A notebook that will kill
anyone whose name is written in it!
Could it be!? The Death N—
Whoops, my bad. It's a Monokuma File.
You...did that on purpose, didn't you?

The Monokuma File is a detailed report that
summarizes all the info about the dead body!

But there's no info that would point to the
blackened, cuz that would ruin the trials.

I dunno, maybe you guys'll find it useful since
you're not experienced investigators, y'know?

Pfft, Monokuma File? Like hell am I 
gonna believe something he made.

Whether you believe it or not, it would still
be prudent to examine its contents, no?

Atua has spoken... He says we shouldn't
take our eyes off of the Monopad.
<CLT=cltMIND>Yeah... I think we should read it.

<CLT=cltMIND>This file has all the info about the victim?
I wonder what it says.

<CLT=cltMIND>The victim is Rantaro Amami...
It doesn't say what his <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltMIND> talent is...

<CLT=cltMIND>The victim's body was discovered
in the library.
<CLT=cltSTRONG>The estimated time of death is 9:10 p.m.<CLT=cltMIND>

<CLT=cltMIND>The victim was subjected to blunt force trauma
to the back of the skull...

<CLT=cltMIND>resulting in cranial fractures and immediate
death. No other injuries were detected.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Monokuma File 1<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltMIND>It doesn't say whether or not he's the
mastermind... Well, that's obvious...

<CLT=cltMIND>But the killing game is still going on...so
I'm gonna assume he wasn't, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>But if Rantaro wasn't the mastermind...
then who is?

I know it's a little late, but...
seeing this makes it real...
Rantaro...is really dead.
This is the mastermind's fault...
The mastermind killed Rantaro...

...Mastermind? I'm sorry, what are we
talking about?

Kaede... Please explain what is going on,
and spare us no detail.
Yeah, I will...
<CLT=cltMIND>Shuichi and I explained to everyone...

<CLT=cltMIND>We told them about the possibility of the
mastermind hiding among us...

<CLT=cltMIND>And about the trap we had set in the
library to lure them out...

<CLT=cltMIND>And that <CLT=cltSTRONG>someone<CLT=cltMIND> got snagged in our
trap, so we came to the library to check...
<CLT=cltMIND>...and discovered Rantaro's body.

I see... So that is what happened. I was not
aware you two had planned such a thing.

Kh! So you used those cameras I modified
for this bullshit!?

But...why would you keep something so 
important a secret from us?

Once we knew one of us was the mastermind, 
we'd start fighting over who it was...

That's what you two were afraid of, 
wasn't it?
Y-Yeah... That's right...

But if there are cameras, won't this case
be solved really easily?
Aw maaan, that's so boring!

Your amusement is the least of our concerns!
We need to check the cameras right now!

The culprit should be in the pictures.
It'll be case closed.
Alright, let me go get the cameras...

<CLT=cltMIND>Shuichi quickly retrieved all three cameras
and rushed back to everyone.
Okay, I've got them.

It was hard removing the camera that Kaede
set up, she really taped it down well...

Well, I really didn't want that camera to fall,
since it was aimed at the moving bookcase.
Here. It's these three cameras.
Now, we just have to develop the film...
Allow me to perform that task.

Wow! Is there anything the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Maid<CLT=cltNORMAL>
can't do!?

I heard everything you said! If that's what
you need, just leave it to me!
Huh?

I'll develop the photos so you bastards can
focus on the investigation!

Cuz if you guys get punished, it would be
way too gory!
H-Hey! Don't butt into our—

<CLT=cltMIND>But she ignored my objection, walked up to
Shuichi, and took the cameras from him.

I am a strong, sensual woman.
Do not underestimate me.
Hey! Give those back!
No need to worry.

We all have to follow the rules. We won't
do anything underhanded or devious.

So I'll let you know when I'm finished
developing the photos.
W-Wait! Give the cameras back!

<CLT=cltMIND>It was pointless to yell at her.
Monophanie left as swiftly as the wind.
Awwww, there she goes.
N-No... That was important evidence.

I'm sorry...
I-I was being careless...

It probably okay. She say she develop photos,
then give photos back.

And she said she had to follow the rules, so
I don't think she would destroy evidence.

Looks like we've got no choice but 
to believe that.

It's important to believe. Atua only shows
mercy to those who believe.

Kaede...I know you're worried, but you
can trust me. We just have to be patient.
That's not all I'm worried about...

I thought this whole thing would be over
once we exposed the mastermind...

But now...we're just in a bigger mess.
A mess...we have to see through to the end.

Ah...Kaede?
I...have a proposal for you.

If it's alright with you...could we keep working
together during the trial? Like we're doing now?
Shuichi?

I know I'm just an apprentice, but...I think
I can help you, as a detective.
No, I...I *want* to help you.

Of course! With you at my side, it'll be like
having 100 people helping me!
...Thank you, Kaede.

Hey, sooo...I don't care about this mushy
stuff, so let's just get started already.

And try to take this seriously, okay?
Our lives are on the line.

It takes a lot of mental power to say 
something like that so cheerfully...

Before we start, I'd like to suggest that we
not investigate by ourselves.
Huh? Why?

If we let the culprit work by themselves, 
they might try and destroy evidence, right?

Oh, you're right... Since the culprit 
is one of us...

Kehehe... If each of us watches the other, 
no one will be able to hide any evidence.

I do not intend to offer a suggestion that
would further arouse suspicion, but...

No, that's logical! Please speak your
mind, Kirumi!

It's not something you should be proud to say...
but I guess we don't have a choice.

After all, if we don't find out who the 
culprit is, we'll all be killed.
<CLT=cltMIND>Yeah... We have to do it.

<CLT=cltMIND>Once we expose the mastermind,
we'll be able to escape...
<CLT=cltMIND>We can definitely do it!

Something is bothering me...
Why did Rantaro come to the library?

It seems likely that he is not the mastermind.
What reason did he have for coming here?

I'm guessing it had something to do with
what Rantaro mentioned earlier...

It's not about outfoxing everyone in this
killing game, it's about ending the game itself.
That's the real goal.
Ending the game itself...

Then it's possible...he noticed the hidden
door in the library, just like we did.
What?

He might have come to the same conclusion
we did, that the mastermind would come here.
You mean...he had the same idea as us?
N-No way... He should've told us...
We could've worked together...

<CLT=cltMIND>I collapsed to the floor, crushed by the weight
of my frustration.

No, he probably couldn't risk telling us...
Like you said, he was suspicious of everyone.

I have you, Kaede, but Rantaro
didn't have anyone he could trust.

That might have been...
the only difference between me and him.
<CLT=cltMIND>As he said that, he offered me a hand.

<CLT=cltMIND>I took his hand and he firmly pulled me
to my feet.

Kaede...let's go.
We can't waste time now.

You're not going to give up, right?
You're...going to save everyone.
Shuichi...

<CLT=cltMIND>He's right...
I can't give up now.

Thanks... I feel like...I can rely on you even
more...
Huh?

<CLT=cltMIND>Shuichi is right.
We can't give up until it's over.

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't stay depressed forever. I have to
help everyone get out of here.

<CLT=cltMIND>We have to continue the investigation.
We gotta find the mastermind.

Hey, Kaede...do you remember what we
saw when we came in here?
Yeah, I remember.

We saw the moving bookcase close on its
own, right?

No one even touched it, so how did that
happen?

Actually, it has to do with
<CLT=cltSTRONG>how the bookcase works<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

<CLT=cltMIND>Shuichi moved the bookcase to reveal
the hidden door.

Take a look at this.
If I let go of the bookcase...

<CLT=cltMIND>He let go of the bookcase, and after
waiting for a bit...
Oh! It closed on its own!

The bookcase is set up like an automatic
door. It closes after a period of time...

It makes perfect sense when
you think about it.

If it didn't close on its own, you wouldn't be able
to put the bookcase back after you went inside.

I see... The bookcase has to close on its own
once you go through the hidden door.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Moving Bookcase<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

But, wait... If the bookcase closes itself
after you enter the hidden door...

Oh! Maybe the reason why the bookcase
closed itself...

...was because the mastermind was hiding
just past the hidden door!

After killing Rantaro, they ran through the
hidden door... It certainly is possible.
Let's check that now.
Huh? How do we check it?
The dust on the card reader, remember?

<CLT=cltMIND>Shuichi moved the bookcase again to
reveal the hidden door once more.
Alright, let's see...

<CLT=cltMIND>We leaned in to get a closer look
at the gap of the card reader.
Huh? The dust is still there.

It looks like the card reader wasn't used.
That means the mastermind didn't hide here.

What if the mastermind replaced the dust
after they used the card reader?

No, I remember exactly where I put the
dust. This hasn't been moved at all.

I think it's safe to assume the mastermind
did not go through this door.

Then the one who moved the moving
bookcase at the time was...
...Rantaro himself?

I...can't say for sure. We'll know more
when we get the pictures back.

There's a chance that someone
else was hiding here.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Card Reader Dust<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

Well, I still think the mastermind is the
culprit.

So we just need to find the clues that
can connect us to the mastermind.
We'll end the killing game that way, too.

Hey, Shuichi.
I need some advice...
What do you think we should check first?

I'm thinking about it, too...but since you're
a detective, you might know more than me.
Hm, what we should check first...

...is if the areas where we placed the cameras
have changed in any way.
Like the bookcases, the vent...

I feel like there might be
clues around there.
I see...

Also, I...think there may be clues around
Rantaro's body. It might be...hard to do, but...

And finally, we need to hear
from everyone here.

One of them might have
noticed something we missed.
Okay, got it. Thanks, Shuichi.

Ah, it's no problem at all...
I hope I can be of *some* use...
So what we should investigate here is...

First, see if the areas around where we placed
the cameras have changed in any way.
Like the bookcases, the vent...

I feel like there might be
clues around there.

Also, I...think there may be clues around
Rantaro's body. It might be...hard to do, but...

And finally, we need to hear
from everyone here.

One of them might have
noticed something we missed.

We should pay close attention
to everyone's alibis.

We need to verify where everyone was
during the timeframe when Rantaro was killed.

If that's the case, then who should we
question?

The six people that went down to
the basement with Rantaro...
Kaito, Gonta, Maki, Tenko, Angie, and Himiko.
Let's talk to them first.

I'm fairly certain they were also in the Game
Room next to the library...

We should ask them
what they were doing there.
Okay... Let's go find them.
Conversation with Kaito Momota.
Well?

If you're the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>, then you've
got your eyes on the culprit, right?
...What?

Tell me who you think the culprit is.
I don't mind if it's just an <CLT=cltSTRONG>educated guess<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Oh, I wanna know too...

Ah, no, I'm sorry...
I can't say anything yet...

But...there's someone you're a little bit 
suspicious of, right? No, there's gotta be.
Ah...

But you're afraid of that. You're afraid 
of suspecting someone, aren't you?
That's how it looks to me.

But with things the way they are, wouldn't it
be better for you to suspect others more?
And let me just warn you...

The way the world works is that <CLT=cltSTRONG>those who 
speak, win<CLT=cltNORMAL>. The truth can easily be twisted.

In order to fix a twisted truth, you need 
something even more powerful.
What do you mean?

I mean that <CLT=cltSTRONG>testimonies without evidence<CLT=cltNORMAL>
are powerless. Be careful.

The way the world works is that <CLT=cltSTRONG>those who 
speak, win<CLT=cltNORMAL>. The truth can easily be twisted.

In order to fix a twisted truth, you need 
something even more powerful.

I mean that <CLT=cltSTRONG>testimonies without evidence<CLT=cltNORMAL>
are powerless. Be careful.
Conversation with Gonta Gokuhara
Conversation with Kokichi Ouma
Conversation with Korekiyo Shinguji
Conversation with Keebo

Why did the culprit not step forward and
take advantage of the First Blood Perk?
What?

The culprit must have killed to survive, so
it is odd that they would not step forward.
True... I wonder what that means...

I can think of several possibilities,
but the worst case scenario is...

...the culprit's objective wasn't to <CLT=cltSTRONG>survive<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
it was to <CLT=cltSTRONG>kill everyone here<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
E-Everyone!?

That would explain why they would forgo
their survival in favor of a class trial.

But...doesn't that seem like a bit of a
stretch to you?

Well, if the culprit is also the mastermind,
then it's certainly plausible.

W-Well, true... Killing us all does seem like
something the mastermind would do...

So we cannot lose this fight... Even on this
uncharted path, we must find our way.

The mastermind's objective is not to
survive, but to kill us all.

That would explain why they would forgo
their survival in favor of a class trial.

So we cannot lose this fight... Even on this
uncharted path, we must find our way.
Conversation with Himiko Yumeno
Conversation with Maki Harukawa
Conversation with Tenko Chabashira

I don't know who killed Rantaro, but it's 
Monokuma's fault it happened.
Because he pressured us...this happened.

That <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL> he gave us is part of it,
and so is that strange music...

He played that music at such a high volume 
to make us feel sick and want to kill...

It was awful...
I thought I'd go crazy.

I bet...someone felt pressured by that 
and killed Rantaro...
It's all...Monokuma's fault.

Anyway...we have to stop the mastermind so
this is the last murder that ever happens here!
We just have to.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Promotional Video BGM<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

I don't know who killed Rantaro, but it's 
Monokuma's fault it happened.

He played that music at such a high volume 
to make us feel sick and want to kill...

It was being played throughout the entire
academy. I was about to lose my mind.

I bet...someone felt pressured by that 
and killed Rantaro...
It's all...Monokuma's fault.
Conversation with Angie Yonaga

Don't talk to me, crotch-itch!
I'm fuckin' busy!

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu continued ignoring us while she
fiddled with a controller.
What's that controller for?
Dun-dun-duh-dunnnn! It's a prone!
Prone?

I don't mean to butt in to the conversation, 
but...don't you mean "drone"?

If it was a Prone, it'd team up with the rest
of the Ganglion alliance to destroy humanity.
<CLT=cltMIND>I have no idea what she's talking about...

W-Wait a second...
The controller is...

Hah-hahaha!
Now you're gettin' it, dickcheese!

<CLT=cltMIND>She laughed obnoxiously and pointed her
finger upward.

Hah! Feast your eyes on the latest creation
from the gorgeous girl genius, Miu Iruma...
It's a drome!
I told you, that's a drone.

If it was a drome, it'd be leading a pack
of vicious monsters!
I don't get it.
When did you have time to make this...?

I got bored after I made those cameras you
asked for, so I modified this RC plane.

I even decked it out with a camera so it'll
take perfect aerial photographs!

From there, I'll use the photos as a reference
to draft a floor plan to help the investigation!

This way, I get outta havin' to do any actual
investigative legwork! Bwah-hahaha!
<CLT=cltMIND>Drafting a floor plan...with photos?

That's amazing...
I'm sure this will help with the investigation.

The only problem is, I'm not used to operatin'
a drone and takin' pictures with it!

You shouldn't be proud of that...and if you
don't hurry, the investigation will end soon!

I can't do shit about that! So just calm
your tiny tits and shut up!!

Sh-Shut up, you! My chest is way better
than your nasty cow udders!
Heeeee!!!
U-Udders...! Udders...!?

You're a bit wimpy when someone stands up to
you, huh? You're actually a complete wuss.

Don't talk to me, you ugly skank!
Quit interrupting the investigation!

Huh!? Dammit, the shot's outta focus again!
Your fuckin' face is blurring the lens, bitch!

<CLT=cltMIND>The floor plan might be useful to the
investigation...

<CLT=cltMIND>But it might not be finished in time for the
class trial... I guess I won't expect too much.

<CLT=cltMIND>I feel like I'm missing something...
I should investigate a little more.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>The time limit to start the killing game
had almost expired...

<CLT=cltMIND>But then the countdown stopped, and that
obnoxious noise went away, too.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what would've happened if the
time limit had expired...

<CLT=cltMIND>Tons of books are crammed into the bookcase,
and arranged in various stacks on top.

It doesn't seem as if anything has changed
since we set up the cameras...

The books that you stacked
up haven't moved.

Oh, you mean the ones I stacked to keep
people from going through the vent.
Yeah...those have been left alone.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Stacked Books<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltMIND>There are lots of books jam-packed in the
bookcases.

<CLT=cltMIND>The books I arranged in the front of the
vent seem to have been left alone.

<CLT=cltMIND>The moving ladder I used to reorganize
the books on top of the bookcases.
<CLT=cltMIND>Nothing out of the ordinary here...

<CLT=cltMIND>The vent is open... I was the one who took
off the grate and left it in the duct.

And we were keeping watch in the
classroom this vent leads to.

I don't think the culprit came
in or out through there.
Yeah, that's true.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Library Vent<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltMIND>The vent looks exactly how I left it when 
I removed the grate earlier.

<CLT=cltMIND>Shuichi and I were on lookout in the
classroom that connects to this vent...
<CLT=cltMIND>I doubt anyone could've gone through here.

<CLT=cltMIND>The moving bookcase is closed right now,
so the hidden door is currently out of sight.

You guys set up a security sensor on 
top of this bookcase, right?

Y-Yeah, it should still be there...
Let me check.

<CLT=cltMIND>Shuichi climbed up the ladder and looked
on top of the moving bookcase.

It's still here.
I should take it down now...

Removing it is fine, but won't your receiver
go off when you move it?

No, it's alright.
I turned the receiver off.
Huh? You can turn it off?

Yes, I made sure to switch it
off on the way down here.

I thought the mastermind could still be
inside, and I didn't want to alert them...
I see... Smart thinking.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Receiver on Shuichi<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltMIND>The moving bookcase is closed right now,
so the hidden door is currently out of sight.

<CLT=cltMIND>We were supposed to expose the mastermind
here, and put an end to everything...

<CLT=cltMIND>The moving bookcase is closed right now,
so the hidden door is currently out of sight.

<CLT=cltMIND>The bookcase automatically closes after
a certain amount of time.

<CLT=cltMIND>So even if the mastermind goes through the door,
the bookcase will go back to its original place.

<CLT=cltMIND>However, the dust Shuichi placed on the card
reader hasn't been touched at all...

<CLT=cltMIND>Which means the mastermind didn't go
through...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's the front door that leads directly to the
basement stairs.

<CLT=cltMIND>We went through this door before we
discovered Rantaro's body.

We entered the library through here
with Kaito and Tenko...

Yeah...we saw the moving bookcase close,
and then when we ran over...

We found Rantaro's body
behind that bookcase...

Hm, I wonder if Rantaro entered through
the same door as we did...
Maybe the mastermind did, too...

When we see the pictures after the
Monokubs develop them, that will be clear.
I guess all we can do is wait.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's the front door that leads directly to the
basement stairs.

<CLT=cltMIND>We went through this door before we
discovered Rantaro's body.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is where Shuichi, Kaito, Tenko, and I
entered the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>When we saw the moving bookcase close,
we rushed over...

<CLT=cltMIND>and then we found Rantaro's body
near that bookcase at the back...

<CLT=cltMIND>We don't know who entered through here...
and who left...

<CLT=cltMIND>We won't know until we get the pictures
from the Monokubs.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the rear door... It's the furthest door
from the stairs and it leads to the hallway.

By the way, this is a sliding door.
See? It opens when you slide it.
Yes, I saw that.

Do you think Rantaro entered through
this door?

I can't say for sure until we get
those pictures back from the Monokubs...
You're right. We'll just have to wait.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the rear door... It's the furthest door
from the stairs and it leads to the hallway.
<CLT=cltMIND>Who went through this door...?

<CLT=cltMIND>I guess we'll find out once the Monokubs are
finished developing the film.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a mysterious globe...but I don't think
it has anything to do with this incident.

<CLT=cltMIND>Looks like the books I stacked on top of the
bookcases haven't been touched.

I'm pretty sure I don't need to tell you this,
but shouldn't we investigate Rantaro's body?

Yes...
If we want to find clues, we have to...

But if it's too much for you, Kaede,
you don't have to, okay?
No, it's fine. I can do it.

<CLT=cltMIND>My mind was set, and I started to
walk toward Rantaro's body.
